status: Engineering candidate; Sponsor publication review pending
authority: Direct Sponsor WO-07C three-part work order and explicit source/transport/restoration authorization

questions.wording: What broader completed 1D visual context is visible relative to the proposed Intraday direction?
How clearly organized is the surrounding completed 1H price structure?
Does completed 15M evidence show an organized base or consolidation relevant to the current move?
What does permitted completed 15M evidence show about establishment, follow-through or failure of the visible move?
How orderly is the permitted completed 5M pullback or progression within the current move?
How does permitted completed price action interact with the supplied governed level or zone?
questions.instruction: Use only an explicitly supplied governed level/zone and qualified visible anchor; otherwise report NOT_OBSERVABLE or unavailable. Never invent a barrier.

questions.wording: What visible structural space exists in the proposed direction before the next clearly relevant obstacle?
questions.instruction: Describe visual space only; do not calculate a Target, Stop, Entry, R:R or profit forecast.

questions.wording: Relative to the most recent clearly visible base or structure, is permitted completed price action visibly extended?
At the relevant governed structure or level, what acceptance, rejection, retest-hold or return-through is visible?
questions.instruction: Use only an explicitly supplied governed level/zone and qualified visible anchor; otherwise report NOT_OBSERVABLE or unavailable. Never invent a barrier.

questions.wording: Is there a material visible condition not adequately represented by Q1-Q9?
questions.instruction: NONE requires a null explanation. MATERIAL_OBSERVATION requires why_not_covered_elsewhere; do not repeat Q1-Q9.

questions.wording: What broader completed 1D international benchmark context is visible relative to the proposed direction?
How organized is the completed 4H international benchmark structure?
What completed 15M benchmark base or consolidation is visible?
How orderly is the completed 5M benchmark progression, pullback or follow-through?
What benchmark location, acceptance or rejection is visible at the supplied lawful structure?
questions.instruction: Use only a clearly observable structure in temporally qualified evidence. If its anchor or correspondence cannot be established, report NOT_OBSERVABLE or UNCLEAR. Do not invent a break threshold.

questions.wording: What broader completed 1D native MCX context is visible relative to the proposed direction?
How organized is the completed 4H native MCX structure?
What does completed 15M native setup context show about follow-through, stalling or failure?
How orderly is the permitted completed 5M native MCX pullback or progression?
How does native MCX interact with the supplied governed level through acceptance, rejection, retest or return-through?
questions.instruction: Use only an explicitly supplied governed level/zone and qualified visible anchor; otherwise report NOT_OBSERVABLE or unavailable. Never invent a barrier.

questions.wording: Does native MCX structure confirm, partially confirm or conflict with the international benchmark structure?
Within comparable permitted evidence, is the benchmark apparently leading, moving with MCX, or is MCX leading or diverging?
questions.instruction: Visual contemporaneous observation only, not measured latency or causality. Insufficient timing correspondence is NOT_OBSERVABLE.

questions.wording: Where a lawful structural break or acceptance exists, does corresponding benchmark behaviour confirm native MCX behaviour?
questions.instruction: Use only a clearly observable structure in temporally qualified evidence. If its anchor or correspondence cannot be established, report NOT_OBSERVABLE or UNCLEAR. Do not invent a break threshold.

questions.wording: Is there material visible structural disagreement between the benchmark and native MCX?
questions.instruction: Currency, basis, contract timing and sessions may differ. Divergence is not a trade rejection or proof either market is wrong.

questions.wording: Is there a material native/reference observation not represented by R1-R5, M1-M5 or X1-X4?
questions.instruction: NONE requires a null explanation. MATERIAL_OBSERVATION requires why_not_covered_elsewhere; do not repeat earlier observations.
